feature_flag: live Slack collection and scheduled registration remain separately bound/default-OFF
authority_notes: This manifest publishes the native Slack coverage/cursor receipt contract used by downstream refs-only adapters. It does not activate a workspace token, Scheduled Task, collector, archive MCP, source call, backup generation, restore acceptance, task mutation, or cross-project access. Raw message and attachment bytes remain in the exact private custody owner under its binding and are never module-manifest payload.
